requested_changes.title: Executed or resumed failing leaf is classified NOT_RUN
requested_changes.cause: case_results is appended only after native, wire, DB and vector qualification all pass. NOT_RUN is computed from len(case_results), so the current leaf is included even after run() resumed test2json/test/CLI or native0 completed and later proof validation failed.
requested_changes.minimal_change: Track each of the two fixed leaf states independently: requested, launch result/resumed, native completion, evidence qualified. Keep unresolved actual exit nullable. NOT_RUN must contain only genuinely not-started leaves; keep STARTED_FAILED or EXECUTED_UNQUALIFIED distinct. Save state in failure/finally and preserve original invocation. Do not infer native failure from proof failure.
completion_controls_NOT_RUN: First leaf resumed/native1 -> first EXECUTED_FAILED, second NOT_RUN.
First leaf native0 followed by missing/wrong closed proof -> first EXECUTED_UNQUALIFIED, second NOT_RUN.
CreateProcess failure before resume -> preserve error and no fabricated executed/native0.

requested_changes.title: Proxy response headers and response bytes are attributed to the wrong boundary
requested_changes.cause: The proxy calls w.WriteHeader(resp.StatusCode), reads the upstream response and records resp.Header.Clone()/responseRaw before w.Write(responseRaw). It never forwards those headers to w. Thus layer=proxy response_headers are upstream-client headers, not CLI-facing response headers; written byte count/error is also unobserved. The upstream wrapper snapshots handler headers before net/http adds transport headers, so it cannot claim all client-observed wire headers either.
requested_changes.minimal_change: Use separate explicitly named upstream-received, handler-committed and CLI-facing response evidence. Capture actual writer status/header snapshot and accepted write bytes/errors, without silently changing proxy forwarding behavior. If claiming client-observed full headers use an authorized transport-boundary capture. Tie request/response records with exact command/request hash and per-layer admission sequence; do not treat completion-file order as cross-layer request order. Preserve raw body before decoding and original assertions.
completion_controls_NOT_RUN: Upstream-only sentinel header not forwarded by proxy must not be reported as CLI-facing.
Short/error response write remains partial/error and cannot claim full response transmitted.
Two ordered requests retain arrival/admission sequence and paired upstream/proxy identities.

requested_changes.title: HTTP limit is post-dispatch and overflow evidence is discarded
requested_changes.cause: Proxy forwards via http.DefaultClient.Do before cli43Wire increments its count. On >32 cli43Wire t.Errorf then returns without recording the overflow exchange. Upstream wrapper also receives/increments call33 before returning503 without cli43Wire. Runner counts only saved wire files, so counts are not total actual attempted/received legs and request33 is not prevented at the forwarding boundary. Native test failure should stop, but it does not establish the advertised maximum transport legs.
requested_changes.minimal_change: Add explicit dispatch/admission budget before each fixture-owned outbound HTTP operation, including setup and proxy forwarding, and preserve attempted/admitted/completed/rejected counters plus overflow raw metadata. At unavoidable server ingress distinguish received attempt from admitted operation; never drop overflow facts or describe <=32 records as all traffic. Enforce the declared total128 consistently or revise the exact cap semantics for Root review; no silent broader scope.
completion_controls_NOT_RUN: With count32 reached, a33rd proxy forwarding intent does not issue another upstream HTTP request and persists one limit observation.
Setup traffic consumes the same upstream allowance and is not omitted.
Overflow/failed requests appear in final actual counters even when native test fails.
